# Sparsh Patil

> Sparsh Santosh Patil is a 13-year-old rising tennis player from Navi Mumbai (Panvel taluka, Raigad district), trained at ASA Tennis Academy. Known for his never-giving-up spirit, athleticism, and energetic playing style, he has been competing in AITA and MSLTA tournaments for 3 years. His current AITA Under 14 ranking is #7 (31 May 2026) and ATF ranking is #33 (31 May 2026).

## Pages

- [Home](https://sparshpatil.com/): Hero, about section, achievements highlights, track record stats and AITA ranking charts, recent news coverage, and contact information.
- [Achievements](https://sparshpatil.com/achievements/): Full list of tournament results with photos.

## About

Sparsh has been playing tennis since 2022 at ASA Tennis Academy, guided by his coaches and parents. He competes in AITA (All India Tennis Association) and MSLTA (Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association) tournaments across the Under 12, Under 14, and Under 15 age categories. Off the court he is a cheerful, curious kid with a hunger to learn and explore.
